project: Rudolf Blaschka America 1892 transport / handoff / split-workshop study
current_thesis: 1892 split the Blaschka workshop without stopping production. Transport kept the split workshop coupled by converting plants, models, papers and references into differently movable, handleable, inspectable, certifiable, countable and settleable forms. Later shipments aggregated asynchronous production histories into apparently coherent consignments, while customs release, accounting and exhibition installation could continue the object's mobility history after physical arrival.
core_mechanisms: handoff and temporary reassignment of authority
split workshop: travelling Rudolf + stationary Leopold production
